meta.name: baseline
meta.note: Method (a) counts the chunks the prerendered HTML references. Method (b) counts every script the browser fetched until network idle plus the settle time, so it also counts chunks that the router prefetch pulls in for the pages behind visible links (see the no-prefetch target).

methodA.what: First-load JS rebuilt from the build output, no network
methodA.compression: gzip level 6 and brotli quality 11 of each file, summed (brotli quality 3 is kept too, because that is what the production CDN sends)

polyfill.note: noModule polyfill chunk, listed in build-manifest polyfillFiles; modern browsers do not fetch it, so it is not in the route totals

largestChunks.kind: not in any initial route set

run.modelledAgainst: per-file encoding (gzip level 6 or brotli q11, raw below the compression threshold)
